title: Training Beyond Convergence: Grokking nnU-Net for Glioma Segmentation in Sub-Saharan MRI
mechanism: Train far past apparent convergence (3,500 vs 200 epochs); small sub-regions improved.
adaptation: PF at 20k, 80k, 160k steps with EMA, 5 seeds; crack and inactive play the role of small sub-regions.
min_experiment: Arm: PF 80k and 160k + EMA. Baseline: SUP100-PF 20k + EMA. Metric: crack relF1@2, crack IoU, inactive IoU (test, E1). Kill: 80k not better than 20k by 0.012 relF1@2 or 0.02 inactive IoU.
evidence: R (secondary summaries, not checked in full text): tumor core / enhancing tumor Dice 86.6/86.3 to 90.1/90.2, whole tumor flat.
prior_overlap: BRIEF section 5: longer schedules never varied. Open.
